title: Accounts Assistant
company: Martin Group of Companies - Agency - Permanent
description:
H.W. Martin Holdings Limited

Job Title: Accounts Assistant
Department: Finance
Reporting to: Head of Finance
Location: Blackwell, Derbyshire (J28, M1)
Hours: Full-time 37.5 hours
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Additional benefits: 25 Days Annual Leave + Public Holidays, Fully Paid Company Pension, Life Assurance, Discretionary Bonus, Employee Assistance Programme

About the H. W. Martin Group:

The Martin Group of Companies (est. 1976) provide specialist services to the construction and waste recycling industries, through a trained and certificated workforce of over 1,600 delivering works and support services from design, through to build and onward maintenance. With a turnover of more than 300m and a fleet of over 500 vehicles we are a major contributor in our fields of expertise.

Job Purpose

To provide accounting and administrative support to the Management Accounts team, assisting with the preparation of monthly management accounts and ensuring the smooth running of the department.

The role will involve a combination of routine accounting duties, financial data processing, spreadsheet preparation, reconciliations and general administration. The successful candidate will assist with gathering and organising financial information, maintaining accurate records and preparing supporting schedules for month-end reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Management Accounts Support:

Assisting with the preparation of monthly management accounts.

Preparing and posting month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and depreciation.

Completing regular balance sheet reconciliations and investigating any discrepancies.

Reviewing nominal ledger accounts to ensure transactions are accurately recorded.

Preparing and maintaining supporting schedules for management accounts.

Assisting with month-end and year-end procedures, ensuring deadlines are achieved.

Maintaining the fixed asset register and processing additions, disposals and depreciation.

Assisting with the preparation of year-end accounts and providing supporting information to external auditors.

Producing financial reports and analysis as required by management.

Supporting other members of the Finance Department with day-to-day accounting and administrative tasks.

Assisting with month-end procedures and ensuring deadlines are met.

Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and reporting procedures.

Supporting the Head of Finance with ad hoc financial projects and duties as required.

Skills and Experience

Essential:
- Experience working within a Management Accounts or Finance team.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Good numerical skills and attention to detail.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage own workload.
- Comfortable working with spreadsheets and large volumes of financial information.
- Methodical approach to completing tasks.
- Ability to undertake detailed and repetitive work accurately.
- Good communication skills and confidence liaising with other departments.
- Ability to prioritise tasks and work to deadlines.

Desirable:
- Understanding of management accounts and month-end procedures.
- Experience preparing spreadsheets and financial reports.
- Knowledge of nominal ledger codes and basic accounting principles.
- Experience using accounting software.
- AAT Level 2 or 3, or currently studying towards an accounting qualification.

Personal Attributes:
- Organised, methodical and conscientious.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Self-motivated with the ability to remain focused on longer tasks.
- Reliable and able to work to regular deadlines.
- Proactive approach to identifying and resolving basic issues.
- Flexible and willing to assist colleagues where required.
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.
- Takes pride in completing work thoroughly and accurately.

Next Steps

If you are looking for a new challenge and feel you have the skills to take on this vital role then please submit your CV or use our online Application form below and submit your details.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from any suitably qualified persons.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice to see how we manage your data, which can be found on our website.

title: Finance Administrator

description:

Looking to build your career in finance with a business that's going places?

Edwards Employment Solutions is recruiting for a Finance Administrator / Accounts Assistant to join a growing, forward-thinking business based in Chesterfield.

- Assisting with sales ledger administration and credit control activities.

Whether you're at the beginning of your finance career or already have solid transactional accounts experience, we'd love to hear from you.

- £25,000 £28,000 salary, depending on experience.
- A permanent position with a growing and ambitious business.
- The opportunity to develop your finance career and take on additional responsibility.
- A supportive working environment with direct exposure to the company's finance operations.
- A brand-new office environment.
- A friendly, close-knit and sociable team.
- Regular company social events and activities.
- Company-funded trips and experiences.

Interested?

If you're looking for a finance role where you can contribute, develop and become a valued member of the team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today through Edwards Employment Solutions, or get in touch with our team to find out more.

title: HR and Payroll Administrator
description:
Greys Specialist Recruitment are working with a well-established, growing business to recruit an HR & Payroll Administrator to join its HR team.

This is a varied, hands-on administrative role supporting the day-to-day running of the HR function. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate employee records, assisting with payroll administration, processing employee documentation and providing general HR support to managers and employees across the business.

Working as part of an established team, you'll need to be organised, reliable and comfortable handling confidential information, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a varied administrative workload.

The Role
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the HR team.
- Assist with monthly payroll preparation, checking employee information, timesheets, working hours, holidays and any changes affecting pay.
- Maintain and update employee records, ensuring HR systems and personnel files are accurate and up to date.
- Process new starter and leaver documentation, including preparing contracts and relevant employee paperwork.
- Record employee changes, including personal details, salary amendments and contractual updates.
- Respond to routine employee and manager queries relating to HR administration, payroll, holidays and absence.
- Maintain accurate sickness absence and holiday records.
- Prepare HR letters, documents and general correspondence.
- Assist with recruitment administration, including arranging interviews and coordinating pre-employment checks.
- Support the administration of pensions, benefits and other employee-related processes.
- Handle confidential employee information appropriately and in line with data protection requirements.
- Provide general administrative support across the wider HR function as required.

About You

We're looking for someone with previous experience in an administrative role, ideally within HR or payroll.

You'll be organised, methodical and comfortable working with employee information, spreadsheets and computer-based systems. Good attention to detail is essential, particularly when dealing with payroll information and maintaining accurate records.

You'll also need good communication skills, a professional approach and the ability to handle confidential information. The ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines and work effectively as part of a team is important.

Experience using HR or payroll systems would be beneficial, alongside a working knowledge of payroll processes and general HR administration.

The Opportunity

An opportunity to join an established and growing business, providing essential administrative support to its HR function. The role offers a varied workload within a busy team and will suit someone who enjoys a structured, organised and hands-on administrative position.

Salary and Benefits
- Salary of 29,000 per annum.
- Full-time, permanent position.
- Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm.

Immediate start available.

To Apply

For further information or to apply, contact David at Greys Specialist Recruitment.

About the H. W. Martin Group:

The Martin Group of Companies (est. 1976) provide specialist services to the construction and waste recycling industries, through a trained and certificated workforce of over 1,600 delivering works and support services from design, through to build and onward maintenance. With a turnover of more than 300m and a fleet of over 500 vehicles we are a major contributor in our fields of expertise.

Job Purpose

To provide efficient and accurate support to the Finance Department, with responsibility for the day-to-day administration of both the Sales Ledger and Purchase Ledger functions.

The successful candidate will ensure that sales invoices are raised and processed accurately, supplier invoices are recorded and paid in a timely manner, and customer and supplier accounts are maintained and reconciled. The role will also involve liaising with customers, suppliers and internal departments to ensure the smooth running of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Ledger:

Raising and processing customer sales invoices accurately and in a timely manner.

Ensuring invoices are raised in accordance with customer contracts, purchase orders and agreed rates.

Distributing sales invoices to customers and ensuring all supporting documentation is provided where required.

Processing customer credit notes and amendments.

Monitoring customer accounts and allocating incoming payments against outstanding invoices.

Carrying out regular customer account reconciliations.

Monitoring aged debt and assisting with credit control activities.

Contacting customers regarding overdue invoices and outstanding payments.

Investigating and resolving customer invoice queries and discrepancies.

Maintaining accurate customer account details and records.

Assisting with month-end sales ledger reporting and reconciliations.

Purchase Ledger:

Receiving, checking and processing supplier invoices and credit notes onto the accounting system.

Ensuring invoices are correctly coded to the appropriate nominal ledger codes, departments and contracts.

Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.

Dealing with supplier queries relating to invoices, outstanding balances and payments.

Preparing and processing weekly and monthly supplier payment runs, ensuring invoices are paid in accordance with agreed payment terms.

Ensuring supplier accounts are accurate and kept up to date.

Assisting with month-end purchase ledger procedures.

Maintaining accurate electronic records and supporting documentation.

Skills and Experience

Essential:
- Previous experience working within an accounts or finance department.
- Experience of sales ledger and/or purchase ledger processing.
- Good understanding of basic accounting principles.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines.

Personal Attributes:
- Reliable, organised and proactive approach to work.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Professional and confident when dealing with customers and suppliers.
- Good problem-solving skills and ability to use initiative.
- Flexible approach to supporting the wider Finance Department.
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.

description:

Department: Finance
Reporting to: Head of Finance
Location: Blackwell, Derbyshire (J28, M1)
Hours: Part-Time Minimum 25 Hours/Week
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience, with benefits
Additional benefits: 25 Days Annual Leave + Public Holidays (pro rata based on days worked), Fully Paid Company Pension, Life Assurance, Discretionary Bonus, Employee Assistance Programme

About the H. W. Martin Group:

The Martin Group of Companies (est. 1976) provide specialist services to the construction and waste recycling industries, through a trained and certificated workforce of over 1,600 delivering works and support services from design, through to build and onward maintenance. With a turnover of more than 300m and a fleet of over 500 vehicles we are a major contributor in our fields of expertise.

Job Purpose

To take responsibility for the day-to-day credit control function, ensuring customer accounts are monitored effectively, and outstanding debts are collected in a timely manner.

The role will involve maintaining regular contact with customers, chasing overdue invoices, resolving payment queries and helping to minimise outstanding debt across the business.

The successful candidate will be organised, confident and proactive, with good communication and negotiation skills and the ability to manage customer relationships professionally whilst ensuring agreed payment terms are adhered to.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Control:

Monitoring customer accounts and reviewing aged debt reports on a regular basis.

Proactively contacting customers regarding outstanding and overdue invoices.

Following up on promised payment dates and ensuring commitments are met.

Sending customer statements and copies of outstanding invoices where required.

Maintaining regular communication with customers to ensure payments are received within agreed terms.

Identifying overdue and high-risk accounts and escalating concerns where necessary.

Monitoring customer accounts against agreed credit limits.

Highlighting accounts approaching or exceeding their credit limits.

Assisting with decisions regarding placing accounts on hold or restricting further services where appropriate.

Maintaining accurate records of all credit control activity and customer communications.

Supporting the business in reducing aged debt and improving cash flow.

Customer Account Management:

Building and maintaining professional relationships with customers.

Responding to customer queries regarding outstanding invoices and account balances.

Investigating payment discrepancies and unallocated cash.

Resolving invoice queries by liaising with internal departments.

Following up on disputed invoices and ensuring queries are progressed promptly.

Liaising with operational teams to obtain supporting documentation, timesheets, purchase orders and job information where required.

Ensuring customer account information and contact details are kept up to date.

Monitoring customer payment patterns and identifying any changes in payment behaviour.

Skills and Experience

Essential:
- Previous experience in a credit control or accounts receivable role.
- Confident and professional telephone manner.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Ability to manage workload independently and prioritise tasks.
- Confident dealing with customers and handling difficult payment conversations.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to work towards targets and meet deadlines.

Personal Attributes:
- Proactive and persistent approach to debt collection.
- Confident and assertive when dealing with overdue accounts.
- Professional and diplomatic when managing customer relationships.
- Organised and methodical.
- Able to work independently and use initiative.
- Resilient and comfortable having difficult conversations.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Reliable and flexible approach to work.
